title: Fourier regularity of an affine subspace indicator
statement: Let $n\ge 0$, let $H$ be a linear subspace of $\mathbb F_2^n$, and let $a\in\mathbb F_2^n$. The indicator of the affine subspace $a+H$, transported to the sign cube $\{\pm1\}^n$ by the coordinatewise binary-to-sign correspondence, has every nonempty-set Fourier coefficient bounded in absolute value by $2^{-d}$, where $d$ is the dimension of the subspace orthogonal to $H$ under the standard dot product over $\mathbb F_2$.
hypotheses_covered: $H$ is a linear subspace of $\mathbb F_2^n$
